Seen from first-person view, the wielder's right hand in a worn brown leather full-finger work glove with dark rust jacket cuff firmly grips the cylindrical brass hilt at lower right. The straight blade is held angled up and across the frame toward upper middle left, showing an immaculate razor bone-white cutting edge, polished brass spine fittings and dark steel core. Calm ready pose, no motion blur, no glowing aura, no magic runes. Clear value separation between the razor bone-white edge, warm brass hilt, scarred leather glove and deep shadowed metal.
